description: AFE cost control and project controls goldens. partnerSplit: calculatePartnerCosts (shares by working interest, operator remainder, validity, the note text, and the conservation identity). metrics: calculateMetrics (BAC, commitments, AC, EAC, VAC, EV, CPI, SPI, percent spent and complete) with the standard EVM set beside it (pv, cv, sv, etc, tcpi are reference only, not engine outputs). sCurve: generateSCurveData points inside the window and the after-window invariant for past windows. evm: projectControls.calculateEVM strings (toFixed(2)) and their numeric values; cpiSpi; gantt: formatTasksForGantt rows with dates as epoch milliseconds (null = Invalid Date). Independent stdlib oracle tools/validation/economics/oracle_afe.py. AFE windows are wholly past (2020) or wholly future (2090 or later): the engine reads the clock and these goldens are valid until 2080. Money in the caller's currency; percentages 0 to 100; days whole. A null where a number is expected is Infinity or NaN in the engine and the case note says which. Timezone assumption UTC.
